purposeJa: 各単元・各項目に同じ教え方を適用しない。現象と学習上のつまずきに応じて導出・図解・実験・反証・構造比較を選び、式の前提と説明できる範囲を点検する。
purposeEn: Select the teaching method that matches each scientific concept and its learning difficulties, rather than imposing a single format. Verify assumptions, model limits, and explanatory power.
